content_of_post_to_answer: How can I maintain my mental health and well-being while dealing with the stress of job preparation and repeated failures?
answer: Repeated failures during job preparation often hurt less because of the result itself and more because every attempt starts feeling like a judgment of your worth. A useful shift is to separate performance feedback from personal identity: an exam or interview can reveal a gap in strategy, timing, or preparation, but it cannot measure your value as a person. Protecting mental health means keeping your learning process honest without letting the outcome define you.
